ex.en: We took out a 30-year mortgage to buy our home.
ex.zh: 我們申請了三十年的房貸買房子。

ex.en: Most of my salary goes to the mortgage.
ex.zh: 我大部分的薪水都拿去付房貸。

ex.en: He compared his car to the new model.
ex.zh: 他拿自己的車和新款比較。

ex.en: This is the latest model of the phone.
ex.zh: 這是這支手機的最新型號。

ex.en: Mike has been making a model plane since breakfast.
ex.zh: 邁克從早餐後就一直在做模型飛機。

ex.en: All models are wrong, but some are useful.
ex.zh: 所有的模型都是錯的，但有些是有用的。

ex.en: She is said to have been a model.
ex.zh: 據說她以前當過模特兒。

ex.en: The model walked down the runway.

ex.zh: 人們建了一座紀念碑來紀念那些士兵。
